On-Page Optimisation

Content Strategy and Content Creation
Developing an Ottawa-relevant content plan targeting informational and commercial search queries

Aligning content to the search intent of Ottawa business owners and their customers

Outreach strategies appropriate to Ottawa's professional and tech sectors

Analytics and Reporting
Monthly transparent reporting on keyword rankings, organic traffic, and conversion-rate indicators
